# nullplatform_parameters (Data Source)

Lists the parameters visible at an NRN: those defined at it and at its ancestors. The listing describes the parameters and never their values — the provider asks the API to leave values out, so secret values are never read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nullplatform = {
      source = "nullplatform/nullplatform"
    }
  }
}

provider "nullplatform" {}

# The parameters visible at an application, without their values
data "nullplatform_parameters" "app" {
  nrn = "organization=1234567890:account=987654321:namespace=1122334455:application=9876543210"
}

output "environment_variables" {
  value = [for parameter in data.nullplatform_parameters.app.parameters : parameter.variable if parameter.type == "environment"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nrn` (String) The NRN to list parameters at, e.g. `organization=1:account=2:namespace=3:application=4`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `parameters` (List of Object) The parameters visible at the NRN, without their values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parameters))

<a id="nestedatt--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parameters`

Read-Only:

- `encoding` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `nrn` (String)
- `read_only` (Boolean)
- `secret` (Boolean)
- `type` (String)
- `variable` (String)
